items.text: Chiefs officially ruled out RB Kenneth Walker for Thursday night vs Bills due to groin injury; rookie Emmett Johnson will start in his place for the third straight game.
items.why: Groin strain, short week rest to heal fully before next Thursday.
items.implication: Misses third straight; handcuff/lead back elevated for TNF.
items.opportunity: Full lead back opportunity for replacement vs BUF.

items.text: 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday dealing with ankle injury from Sunday night vs Vikings; day-to-day per Shanahan.
items.why: Ankle sprain suffered Q2 Sunday night.
items.implication: Availability in question for upcoming game; monitor Thursday/Friday reports.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving this week: since Week 5 only Gibbs and CMC average more PPG among RBs; gets Carolina matchup.
items.why: Elite recent PPG and soft CAR defense.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share expected vs weak run D.

items.text: Jaguars RB Bhayshul Tuten did not practice Wednesday due to foot/ankle injuries that resurfaced/aggravated in Week 11 loss.
items.why: Aggravated right ankle/foot (prior high ankle issues) after being stepped on.
items.implication: Week 12 status uncertain vs Titans; could be rested or limited.

items.text: Levitan on Etienne: could see disappointing snaps/routes down stretch but reasonably high carry count; strong playoff schedule gets ARZ/ATL Weeks 16/17. Cites Graziano context.
items.why: Role shift possible with competition; volume in carries offsets route decline.
items.implication: RB2/flex floor via rushes; upside in favorable late schedule.
items.opportunity: Carry share/goal-line potential remains; routes/snaps caution.

items.text: Berry notes Derrick Henry target share jumped to 12% (4.5 rec/game) in 2 games with Brissett vs prior <6%/1.3; raises PPR floor significantly.
items.implication: Higher floor in PPR; LOVE as RB1/2.

items.text: Jaylen Warren only 51% rush attempts since Dowdle return (low target share, RB20 util); D'Andre Swift 47% snaps/39% rushes with Monangai back, low targets. Both mid/low RB2s now.
items.implication: Downgrade from RB1 fringe to mid-low RB2.

items.text: Puka Nacua (and Terrance Ferguson) out for the season after MCL surgery; ETR Week 12 preview flags as key development.
items.why: MCL surgery (grade 3 tear details later), 4-5 month recovery; also serving suspension on IR.
items.implication: Rams WR corps thinned long-term; target share to remaining WRs/Adams return.
items.opportunity: Elevated roles for healthy Rams pass-catchers.

items.text: Packers WR Christian Watson questionable to return due to thigh injury mid-game vs Rams, then returned.
items.implication: Limited snap impact if managed; monitor post-game.

items.text: Micah Parsons officially active for Packers vs Rams (Zaire Franklin inactive).
items.implication: Defensive boost for GB; no direct fantasy offensive impact listed.

items.text: Berry has Bo Nix on HATE list this week, outside top 20: expects heavy Jonah Coleman (RB) usage vs PIT and insufficient Nix rushing to compensate.
items.why: Run-heavy script likely; limited dual-threat upside observed.

items.text: DeVonta Smith saw 57% target share in Week 11; averages 36% on season, 50% of Eagles end-zone targets. Role better than expected despite injuries.
items.why: Massive target concentration when healthy/Hurts limited.
items.implication: WR1 upside if volume holds; disappointing season volume overall due to injuries.

items.text: Ladd McConkey in return saw season-high 38% target share and 20.7 FP; when >=20% share averages 17.5 PPG (limited sample of healthy snaps).
Trey McBride 39% target share (19 targets) last 2 weeks with backup QBs but aDOT only 3 yards, 1 of 19 >10 air yards; volume keeps top-5 TE PPR but efficiency/yards down (11.8 PPG).
items.why: High volume but short aDOT without Brissett.
items.implication: Still startable TE1 via targets but not elite upside.
